t: Validation Methodology and Standard
title: Validation Methodology and Standard
description: METHODOLOGY: the validation standard applied to every report in this database. VALIDATION METHODOLOGY (applies to every report in this database) 1. SCHEMA: the database's index.jsonl.gz must parse as JSON lines; every record must carry id, title, description, ladder_rank, demo, provenance, last_verified, src. 2. COUNTS: exactly 20 records; ids unique and matching the database's id_prefix + 6 digits. 3. FIELDS: ladder_rank in {1,2,3}; last_verified == 2026-10-21; src is public-harvest (public) or signature-generated-completion (signature). 4. GENERATOR: db-pages/<slug>/gen-<slug>.js passes node --check. 5. PAGE: db-pages/<slug>/index.html exists with the slug, id prefix, id="stCount", search + Exhaustive pill + All Database Merger, tab bar, and the JAH-FULL-SPEC section. 6. DEMOS: a sample of record demos must parse (execution is confirmed separately by the demo-confirmation database). Verdict PASS requires every check green. Evidence below is the actual output of the checks run at build time (2026-10-21). This edition validates 22 lane databases (independently re-run here); the validation/demo-confirmation databases themselves are covered by the lane's final build gate.
demo:
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Validation methodology printer."""
print('VALIDATION METHODOLOGY (applies to every report in this database)
1. SCHEMA: the database's index.jsonl.gz must parse as JSON lines; every record must carry id, title, description, ladder_rank, demo, provenance, last_verified, src.
2. COUNTS: exactly 20 records; ids unique and matching the database's id_prefix + 6 digits.
3. FIELDS: ladder_rank in {1,2,3}; last_verified == 2026-10-21; src is public-harvest (public) or signature-generated-completion (signature).
4. GENERATOR: db-pages/<slug>/gen-<slug>.js passes node --check.
5. PAGE: db-pages/<slug>/index.html exists with the slug, id prefix, id="stCount", search + Exhaustive pill + All Database Merger, tab bar, and the JAH-FULL-SPEC section.
6. DEMOS: a sample of record demos must parse (execution is confirmed separately by the demo-confirmation database).
Verdict PASS requires every check green. Evidence below is the actual output of the checks run at build time (2026-10-21).')
print('targets: 22 databases')
provenance: Signature original composed for the JAH Databases network. Signature-labeled: an original JAH-system creation, not a public record.
